purpose: Evaluate Claude Haiku as a page-scan reader against earlier image-check verdicts (low-importance batch, given approximate page numbers)
agreement: 49/60 overall; 45/47 where the earlier verdict was high-confidence; 44/46 where Haiku was high-confidence
adjudicated_disagreements: 3 checked by enlarged crops: Haiku right twice (both its high-confidence calls, earlier readings wrong), earlier reading right once (Haiku medium-confidence)
conclusion: Haiku high-confidence verdicts usable for applying corrections; medium/low/illegible go to a stronger model or human. Sample is small and the reference is itself model-read.

rows.ref_reading: 以為風疾徹用發散而促其危者（左葉第2行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「徹用」，非「輒」
rows.haiku_reading: 前症往往以為風疾徹用發散而促其危者（左葉第二列，「徹」字）
rows.haiku_note: Printed glyph is 徹 (彳 + 育), not 輒.

rows.ref_reading: 口乾發熱六脈浮數欲用瀉火之藥（右葉第5行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「欲用瀉火」，作「用瀉」；非「為㵼」。「脈」字印本作「脈」
rows.haiku_reading: 但倦怠少食口乾發熱六脈浮數欲用瀉火之藥（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Clear 用瀉 in the column; no 為㵼.

rows.ref_reading: 補中益氣全痊（行末）下接秀才劉貫卿
rows.ref_note: 「痊」後無「愈」字，行止於「全痊」，與四庫同
rows.haiku_reading: 又用補中益氣全痊 — column ends at 痊, next column begins 秀才劉貫卿 (左葉)
rows.haiku_note: No 愈 printed after 痊; the column ends there, so the 愈 in working is absent from print.

rows.ref_reading: 又用補中益氣全痊（左葉第6行，短行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「補中益氣全痊」，有「全」
rows.haiku_reading: 又用補中益氣全痊 (左葉)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 全 before 痊, matching the 四庫 text.

rows.ref_reading: 胸間發癍如蚊所蚋（左葉最末行，字作虫旁+內）
rows.ref_note: 印本字形為「蚋」（虫+內），既非「吶」亦非「咂」；另「癍」字印本作癍（疒旁），與四庫「癍」同、與working「斑」異
rows.haiku_reading: 足胸間發癍如蚊所咂余用補中益氣加薑桂（左葉）
rows.haiku_note: Glyph has 口 radical on the left and a 匝-type right part; reads as 咂, not 吶. Medium because the scan is small print.

rows.ref_reading: 發熱吐痰時欲作嘔自用清氣化痰及二陳枳實之類（左葉第2行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「自用」，非「嘗服」
rows.haiku_reading: 一男子食少胸滿手足逆冷飲食畏寒發熱吐痰時欲作嘔自用清氣化痰及二陳枳實（左葉第二列，「自用」二字）
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 自用 clearly, not 嘗服.

rows.ref_reading: 用益氣湯八味九兩月餘諸症悉愈（右葉第3行）
rows.ref_note: 印本「兩月」後有「餘」字，與四庫同；「丸」刻作「九」
rows.haiku_reading: 如無用益氣湯八味丸兩月餘諸症悉愈（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Print has 餘 between 兩月 and 諸症, matching the 四庫 text; working lacks it.

rows.ref_reading: 侍御譚希曾咳嗽吐痰手足時冷（右葉第5行起）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「侍御」（亻寺），非「待」
rows.haiku_reading: 痰不止必患肺癰矣侍御譚希曾咳嗽吐痰（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Glyph has the 亻 radical (侍), not 彳 (待); matches 四庫 reading.

rows.ref_reading: 後胸腹不利飲食不甘口乾體倦發熱吐痰（右葉第2行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「不甘」（甘字上下均有橫，非廿）
rows.haiku_reading: 後胸腹不利飲食不甘口乾體倦發熱吐痰（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Glyph is 甘 (horizontal top stroke over a closed box with inner bar), not 廿.

rows.ref_reading: 夕而胸次漸舒陟(?)然思食不三日而病去（右葉第9行）
rows.ref_note: 掃描解析度低(96ppi)；字左為阝，右上似「止」形，下似「少」，近「陟」而非「陡」(陡右上為土)；把握不高
rows.haiku_reading: 未竟夕而胸次漸舒陡然思食（右葉，「舒」後一字）
rows.haiku_note: Left component is clearly 阝, so 陟 (步) or 陡 (斗) only; the right component is too small at native resolution. Lean is 陡 (斗 shape, skqs), not confident.

rows.ref_reading: 褚氏遺書精血篇但無冶法耳（左葉小字雙行末）
rows.ref_note: 「治」字左旁似兩點水（冫：一點加一撇），與下行「法」之三點水不同，近「冶」；解析度低故為中等把握
rows.haiku_reading: 詳見褚氏遺書精血篇但無治法耳（左葉末，小字雙行夾注）
rows.haiku_note: Small-print note; the radical is three-stroke 氵 (治), not two-stroke 冫 (冶). Small print, so medium.

rows.ref_reading: 無內瘴外瘴耳鳴耳聾等症（右葉第5行）
rows.ref_note: 印本「外瘴」亦疒旁章；另本頁方名「芍藥清肝散」下印本「脾」作「臟腑秘結」小字，未列
rows.haiku_reading: 久服無內瘴外瘴耳鳴耳聾等症（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Both 內 and 外 spots print 疒+章 (瘴), so the print matches the 四庫 reading here. The 內 spot earlier in the same phrase also reads 瘴 in print, but is not the marked item. Working text reads 障 at both spots.

rows.ref_reading: 入髮煎髮化仍去查徐下黃丹（右葉第3-4行）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「仍去查」（亻+乃），非「乃」；「渣」印本作「查」
rows.haiku_reading: 上用香油二斤四兩煎黑去渣入髮煎髮化仍去粗徐下黃丹（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Glyph has a clear 亻 radical with 乃 on the right: 仍, not 乃.

rows.ref_reading: 餘熱不盡當服此湯（右葉第1行末）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「此湯」，非「此藥」
rows.haiku_reading: 大柴胡下之餘熱不盡當服此湯（右葉）
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 湯 (氵 radical), not 藥.

rows.ref_reading: 磁器內置熱湯頓一日同炒至黃連紫（左葉第3欄）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「頓」（屯+頁），非「燉」；另「磁器」印本作磁（石+茲），與working「瓷器」異
rows.haiku_reading: 入磁器內置熱湯頓一日同炒至黃連紫（左葉）
rows.haiku_note: Right component is the 頁 shape and there is no 火 dot row on the left, so 頓 rather than 燉. Left part is fuzzy at this print size.

rows.ref_reading: 月經不調恪服伐肝之劑
rows.ref_note: 印本作忄旁「恪」，非「却」。
rows.haiku_reading: 作痛或痞悶月經不調恪服伐肝之劑 (恪 printed; 忄 radical with 夂 over 口)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 恪 (忄 + 各), not 却 (去 + 卩). Matches working reading.

rows.ref_reading: 又用歸脾補中二湯以益脾氣生肝血而瘥
rows.ref_note: 印本作「以益脾氣」，與工作本同。
rows.haiku_reading: 又用歸脾補中二湯以益脾氣生肝血而瘥 (以 printed)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 以 in column 湯以益脾; no trace of 兼. Matches working reading.

rows.ref_reading: 又二十餘劑而經行(行字後即段尾，換左葉「前症若脾虛…」)
rows.ref_note: 印本作「而經行」，無「自」亦無「至」，兩本皆異。
rows.haiku_reading: 十餘劑而經行 | 前症若脾虛不能消 (column break between 行 and 前; only 行 between 經 and 前)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 經行 with no 自 before 前症; 行 alone matches neither 自行 nor 至.

rows.ref_reading: 或用清熱分利之藥小便不利
rows.ref_note: 印本作「之藥」。
rows.haiku_reading: 小便短少或用清熱分利之藥 (藥 printed at column foot, glyph 艹 over 樂)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 藥, not 劑. Matches skqs reading.

rows.ref_reading: 頭痛煩渴引冷用人參敗毒
rows.ref_note: 印本作「引冷」(弓旁加豎)，非「飲」(無食旁)。
rows.haiku_reading: 頭痛煩渴引冷用人參敗毒散 (引 printed, followed by 冷)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 引 (弓 + 丨), not 飲. Matches working reading.

rows.ref_reading: 丹皮茯苓治之而痊若陰中有蟲癢痛
rows.ref_note: 印本作「而痊」。
rows.haiku_reading: 芍藥丹皮茯苓治之而 | 若陰中有蟲癢痛 (spot glyph after 而 at top of column; 疒 radical visible, inner component not resolvable at scan resolution)
rows.haiku_note: Glyph after 而 is 疒-radical char; inner part (人/工-like vs 差-like) ambiguous at 400-800 dpi, so neither 瘥 nor 痊 can be confirmed.

rows.ref_reading: 切三文錢厚安瘡頭上用艾壯於蒜上灸之
rows.ref_note: 印本「瘡頭上」，非「瘡頭頭」(四庫另有艾裝、炙，印本作壯、灸)。
rows.haiku_reading: 切三文錢厚安瘡頭上 | 用艾壯於蒜上灸之 (上 printed, small glyph after 頭 with long bottom stroke)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 上 after 瘡頭; not 頭. Matches working reading.

rows.ref_reading: 多得復生切不用刀斷之
rows.ref_note: 印本作「切不用刀斷之」，既非「切不可用」亦非「切勿用」。
rows.haiku_reading: 多得復生切不用刀斷之 (only 不 between 切 and 用)
rows.haiku_note: Print has single 不 before 用; no 可 (working 不可) and no 勿 (skqs).

rows.ref_reading: 一產婦小腹疼小便不利用薏苡仁湯
rows.ref_note: 印本作「小腹疼」，其後直接「小便不利」，無「痛」字。
rows.haiku_reading: 一產婦小腹疼小便不利用薏苡仁 (疼 directly followed by kunten and 小)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 疼 with no 痛 after it, so the working-only 痛 is absent. Matches skqs.

rows.ref_reading: 有痰加二陳湯若勞心力而致者宜補中益氣
rows.ref_note: 印本作「若勞心力」，無「因」字。
rows.haiku_reading: 小便有痰加二陳湯若勞心力而致者宜補 (若 directly followed by 勞)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 若勞心力 with no 因. Working-only 因 is absent. Matches skqs.

rows.ref_reading: 若因腸胃虛弱六君子加升麻柴胡
rows.ref_note: 印本作「六君子加升麻」，有「子」字。
rows.haiku_reading: 若因腸胃虛弱六君子加升麻柴胡 (子 printed between 君 and 加)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 子 after 六君; the skqs-only clause is present. Working text lacks it.

rows.ref_reading: 腹痛／膠 一兩 炙／艾葉 數莖（藥列首字為「膠」）
rows.ref_note: 膠艾湯藥列首行直接是「膠」（小字一兩、炙），其上無「阿」字；四庫加「阿」非印本。其左另行「阿膠散」是下一方標題。
rows.haiku_reading: 胎上搶或去血腹痛 | 膠 (column with 膠 starts at top, nothing printed before it)
rows.haiku_note: No 阿 before 膠; print lacks the skqs-only 阿. Consistent with working (empty).

rows.ref_reading: 飲盡再製亦有／得生者（次欄）
rows.ref_note: 印本「亦有得生者」，有「者」，工作本漏；「得生者」折入次欄。
rows.haiku_reading: 飲盡再製亦有得生者 | 芎歸補中湯治氣血虛半產 (者 printed before the next column)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 者 after 得生, which is the skqs-only clause. Working text lacks it.

rows.ref_reading: 自死龜殼一個如無占過者亦可酥炙｜（次葉首）右為末每一兩水煎服
rows.ref_note: 兩處各異：「炙」字形為夕下火，與工作本「炙」相合；而次葉首字為「右」，與四庫「右」相合，非工作本「上」。故一處從工作本，一處從四庫；「矣」未見。
rows.haiku_reading: 如無占過者亦可酥矣 | 右為末每一兩水煎服 (矣 at column foot, 右 starts next column)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 酥矣右為末; neither 炙上 (working) is present, 矣右 matches skqs. 矣 vs 炙 read at 800 dpi, moderately sure.

rows.ref_reading: 酒黃芩 冬去之 熱甚用
rows.ref_note: 印本「酒黃芩」，工作本漏「黃」。
rows.haiku_reading: 草二錢夏生冬炒酒黃芩冬去之熱甚用 (黃 printed between 酒 and 芩)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 黃 (skqs-only clause); working text lacks it.

rows.ref_reading: 必先於治本而兼以治標
rows.ref_note: 有「於」（先於治本）
rows.haiku_reading: 而元氣又虛者必先於治本而兼以治標 (左葉; 於 printed between 先 and 治)
rows.haiku_note: 於 is printed; 四庫 lacks it.

rows.ref_reading: 或不作膿或膿／成不潰者氣血虛甚也
rows.ref_note: 「成不潰者」，無「而」，工作本多「而」
rows.haiku_reading: 或膿成不潰者氣血虛甚也峻補之 (左葉; 成 is followed directly by 不 in the same column)
rows.haiku_note: No 而 between 成 and 不; working-only 而 not printed.

rows.ref_reading: 六君子加附子／一劑即愈
rows.ref_note: 作「即愈」，四庫「而愈」不符；另同段「春元沈霓川」，印本為「霓」，工作本作「震川」（異於工作本，與四庫「霓川」同）
rows.haiku_reading: 六君子加附子一劑即愈春元沈霓川之內 (右葉)
rows.haiku_note: 即 printed (四庫 而). Side difference: name printed 沈霓川 (霓 matches 四庫), working has 震; not the item spot.

rows.ref_reading: 又朝仍用前湯夕用十全大補湯
rows.ref_note: 有「用」（仍用前湯）
rows.haiku_reading: 劑吐膿漸止又朝仍用前湯夕用十全大補湯 (左葉; 仍 then 用 then 前湯)
rows.haiku_note: 用 is printed between 仍 and 前; working lacks it, 四庫 has it.

rows.ref_reading: 少飲薄粥及服八珍湯固其元氣
rows.ref_note: 作「及服」，工作本「乃服」不符
rows.haiku_reading: 宜徐緩時少飲薄粥及服八珍湯固其元氣 (左葉; 及 printed between 粥 and 服)
rows.haiku_note: 及 printed (四庫); no 乃 at this spot.

rows.ref_reading: 若用克伐之劑欲其消散則腫者不能潰
rows.ref_note: 「用」同四庫，「克」字形似克（無寸旁，未見「尅」）同工作本，故兩者各合一半；同處「欲其消散」亦同四庫（工作本語境作「內消」）
rows.haiku_reading: 若用尅伐之劑欲其消散則癰者不能潰 (左葉; 用 printed, then 尅)
rows.haiku_note: 用尅 printed (四庫), not 以克. 尅 form medium confidence at this resolution. Side notes, low confidence: column reads 當助周壯 where working body has 胃壯; ctx 欲其內消 vs body 欲其消散 not checked further.

rows.ref_reading: 一患者服攻毒等藥（一／患／者／服）
rows.ref_note: 作「一患者」，無「人」
rows.haiku_reading: 四君加歸茋而愈一患者服攻毒等藥 (右葉; 一 then 患者 with nothing between)
rows.haiku_note: No 人 printed (working-only). Side difference: 歸茋 printed, matches 四庫 form, working has 耆.

rows.ref_reading: 瘡自斂矣夫腎主骨
rows.ref_note: 作「矣」，工作本「也」不符
rows.haiku_reading: 則骨自脫瘡自斂矣夫腎主骨 (左葉; 矣 printed after 斂)
rows.haiku_note: 矣 printed (四庫); working 也 not printed.

rows.ref_reading: 便癰 小字「一名便毒／一名＋兩字」
rows.ref_note: 小字雙行第二行「一名」後見兩個字形：上字帶疒旁、類痃/疝，下字似亥形、無明顯疒旁；看不出為重複的「痃痃」，亦無法確認為單「痃」，不作判定
rows.haiku_reading: 便癰 heading with small double-line note 一名便毒 / 一名痃疾 (右葉; second note glyph is 疾)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 痃疾, not working 痃痃; 四庫 has no char at this spot. 痃 (first) and 疾 (second) are small print, read at medium confidence.

rows.ref_reading: 皆因飲食失節起居不時七情
rows.ref_note: 「失節」與「起居不時」之間無「而」
rows.haiku_reading: 因飲食失節起居不時七情六淫 (左葉; 節 then起 with only a small kunten mark between)
rows.haiku_note: No 而 printed; working-only 而 absent.

rows.ref_reading: 爲主因服除濕敗毒等劑
rows.ref_note: 印本字形為囗內「大」，讀「因」；非「固」。
rows.haiku_reading: 陰虛當滋化源為主固服除濕敗毒等劑 (右葉; 固 printed)
rows.haiku_note: 固 printed (四庫), not 因.

rows.ref_reading: 幸矣故凡前症須用托裏
rows.ref_note: 印本作「故凡」。
rows.haiku_reading: 蜂起其不死者幸矣故凡前症須用托裡消毒散 (右葉; 故 printed after 矣)
rows.haiku_note: 故 printed (四庫), not 大.

rows.ref_reading: 生地黃(小字)各一錢/五分
rows.ref_note: 印本小字為「各一錢五分」(「各一錢」右列、「五分」左列)，非「一錢半」。
rows.haiku_reading: 芍藥炒 生地黃各一錢五分 金銀花二錢 (左葉; dose in small double-line print: 各一錢 right, 五分 left)
rows.haiku_note: 五分 printed, not 半 (working).

rows.ref_reading: 蓋氣能攝血故也凡氣血俱虛之症
rows.ref_note: 印本作「凡」。另：下文「宜于前湯」印本似作「于」(工作本作「於」，清單外，中把握)。
rows.haiku_reading: 蓋氣能攝血故也凡氣血俱虛之症宜於前湯 (右葉; 凡 printed after 也)
rows.haiku_note: 凡 printed (working); 四庫 有 若.

rows.ref_reading: 漸如連珠不消不潰或潰而膿水
rows.ref_note: 印本該字為氵旁+肖(「小」上、「月」右)，讀「消」，無攵旁；水印干擾，故中把握。另：「濃/膿」處印本為「膿」(與工作本同)。
rows.haiku_reading: 結硬強漸如連珠不消不潰或潰而膿水不絕 (右葉; 消 printed after 不)
rows.haiku_note: Glyph read as 消 (氵 and 小 radicals) rather than 散; low-res scan, medium confidence. 膿 printed, matching working (四庫 濃).

rows.ref_reading: 生菉豆末芝麻油亦可
rows.ref_note: 印本作「亦可」
rows.haiku_reading: 豆末芝麻油亦可一敷貼雄黃 (spot char printed 亦; right leaf, col. 'mixed with 豆末芝麻油')
rows.haiku_note: Printed 亦 matches 四庫 reading; working 俱 not printed.

rows.ref_reading: 愈後食炙煿等物痰盛作渴（爆字位置印作「煿」火+尃）
rows.ref_note: 印本此處有一字，作「煿」(火旁+尃)，是「爆」之異體/通用字；四庫無此字。有字故歸工作本，但字形非「爆」
rows.haiku_reading: 八味丸尋愈後食炙煿等物痰盛作渴 (glyph between 炙 and 等 has 火 radical)
rows.haiku_note: A character is printed at the spot (absent in 四庫). It looks like 煿 (variant of 爆 in 炙煿) rather than a clear 爆; the same glyph recurs at item 9 (page 67). Form not certain at this scan resolution.

rows.ref_reading: 兼換肌散半載元氣復而諸症退
rows.ref_note: 印本無「乃」
rows.haiku_reading: 氣湯兼換肌散半載元氣復而諸症退時 (no character between 載 and 元)
rows.haiku_note: Print lacks the working-only clause 乃; reads 半載元氣 directly.

rows.ref_reading: 服換肌散之類眉毛頓落遍身作癢
rows.ref_note: 印本作「頓落」；眉字作髟頭異體
rows.haiku_reading: 之類〔髯〕毛頓落遍身作癢 (spot char printed 落)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 落 matches 四庫; working 脫 not printed. Other char before 毛 not part of the differing run.

rows.ref_reading: 膿水漸少又八珍牡丹皮之類
rows.ref_note: 印本「又八珍」無「用」
rows.haiku_reading: 祛風丸膿水漸少又八珍牡丹皮之類 (no character between 又 and 八)
rows.haiku_note: Print lacks the skqs-only clause 用; matches working (no clause).

rows.ref_reading: 服化痰清氣之劑形氣倦怠
rows.ref_note: 印本作「清氣之劑」
rows.haiku_reading: 服化痰清氣之剤形氣倦怠食少胸痞 (spot char printed 剤, the 劑 variant form)
rows.haiku_note: Printed 剤 (variant of 劑) matches the 四庫 reading 劑; working 藥 not printed. Right leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 又服月餘而痊（行末）
rows.ref_note: 末字為疒+全形，作「痊」；非「瘥」
rows.haiku_reading: 又服月餘而痊 spot: 疒 radical clear; right component not resolvable (全 vs 差)
rows.haiku_note: Glyph has 疒 radical; right component could be 全 (痊, working) or 差 (瘥, 四庫). Scan resolution (embedded image pixelates at 600 dpi) does not settle it. Left leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 變為疙瘩臖腫痒甚余用梔子清肝散
rows.ref_note: 印本作「痒甚」，非「痒其」(四庫訛)
rows.haiku_reading: 臖腫 [then column top] 痒其余用梔子清肝散 (printed 疒+羊 variant 痒 then 其)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 痒其 at top of the column after 臖腫 (痒 is the variant of 癢, 其 is the 四庫 character); working 癢甚 not printed. Second character judged 其 rather than 甚 at this resolution. Right leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 一女子性急多怒月經先期
rows.ref_note: 印本「一女子」有「子」
rows.haiku_reading: 一女子性急多怒月經先期 (子 printed between 女 and 性)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 子 (a full character, kunten mark above it is separate). Working text lacks it; 四庫 有子 matches. Right leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 忌一切炙煿厚味止可食淡粥（爆位印作「煿」）
rows.ref_note: 印本此處有一字，作「煿」(火旁+尃)，爆之異體；四庫無此字。字形非「爆」
rows.haiku_reading: 忌一切炙【火+白/暴-like glyph】厚味止可食淡粥 (火 radical clear; right component not resolvable)
rows.haiku_note: A character is printed between 炙 and 厚 (present, so the 四庫 absence is contradicted) but its right component could be 白 (煿, the usual 炙煿厚味) or 暴 (爆, working) at this resolution. Same glyph as item 1 (page 31). Right leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 取淨肉曬乾為末大風症治之
rows.ref_note: 印本作「治之」(氵台)，非「用」
rows.haiku_reading: 土花蛇 ... 肉曬乾為末大風症治之 (small print; 治 clear, 氵 radical visible)
rows.haiku_note: Small-print dose note reads 大風症治之; printed 治 matches the 四庫 reading 治, working 用 not printed. Left leaf, small print.

rows.ref_reading: 以水一碗挼成汁去柤
rows.ref_note: 字為才旁+妥(爫女)形，作「挼」，非「搗」；另「渣」印作「柤」
rows.haiku_reading: 皂角 ... 無灰酒浸一宿以水一碗挼成汁去柤 (small print; 扌 radical with 委-like right part)
rows.haiku_note: Printed glyph reads as 挼 (扌+委-like), matching the 四庫 reading 挼; working 搗 not printed. Small print at ~200-300 dpi, the right component is not fully certain; not 搗 (島) as far as visible. Left leaf, small print.

rows.ref_reading: 聖愈湯：熟地 生者自製 生地黃 當歸
rows.ref_note: 印本作「熟地」，無「黃」
rows.haiku_reading: 熟地 [no character] 生者自製生地黃當歸 (small note 生者/自製 begins directly under 地)
rows.haiku_note: Print reads 熟地 followed directly by the small note 生者自製, with no 黃 in the main line; matches 四庫 (no 黃). Working 熟地黃 not printed. Left leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 右用燈心二十莖水煎服
rows.ref_note: 印本有「服」
rows.haiku_reading: 右用燈心二十莖水煎服 (服 printed at the bottom of the column, before 清心蓮子飲)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 服 after 水煎, matching the 四庫 reading; working text lacks it. Right leaf.

rows.ref_reading: 白癜風方（標題）
rows.ref_note: 印本作「白癜風方」
rows.haiku_reading: 白癜風方人參白朮蒼朮鹽 (風 printed right after 白癜)
rows.haiku_note: Print has 風 in 白癜風方, matching the 四庫 reading; working text lacks it. Right leaf.
